results.title: User namespaces
results.detail: AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces, so bubblewrap cannot isolate commands
results.fix:
sudo tee /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap > /dev/null <<'EOF'
abi <abi/4.0>,
include <tunables/global>

profile bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap flags=(unconfined) {
  userns,
  include if exists <local/bwrap>
}
EOF
sudo systemctl reload apparmor

results.title: Truecolor
results.detail: the terminal does not advertise 24-bit color, so lyna-tmux quantizes the theme to 256 colors
results.fix: export COLORTERM=truecolor (only when the terminal renders 24-bit color), or set ui.color = "256" in config.toml

results.title: Clipboard
results.detail: no clipboard tool found (xclip, xsel, wl-copy), so copy mode cannot write the system clipboard

results.title: Option as Meta
results.detail: Alt sends Meta by default on this platform

results.title: Shift+Enter
results.detail: Shift+Enter may send the prompt instead of adding a line in unknown terminal; doctor cannot press a key to find out
results.fix: run /terminal-setup in Claude Code, in this terminal and not inside tmux; a terminal that already sends the key is left as it is

results.title: Claude keybindings
results.detail: alt+s (Chat, chat:stash) never reaches Claude: M-s is lyna-tmux Scratch shell
results.fix: edit /home/u/.claude/keybindings.json to use other keys, or set ui.alt_keys = false (and workspace.prefix) in config.toml

results.title: Docker
results.detail: the Docker daemon is not reachable: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket
results.fix: sudo usermod -aG docker "$USER" (then log out and back in)

results.title: Neovim
results.detail: Neovim 0.7.2 at /usr/bin/nvim is older than 0.9; the review popup needs 0.9 or newer
